en: 7. The Question on the Bamboo Staff “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘one quality of the bamboo staff should be adopted,’ which is that one quality that should be adopted?
“Just as, Great King, the bamboo staff bends in the direction where the wind blows, and does not run off in another direction;”

In the same way, Great King, a yogī practicing yoga, having brought himself into conformity with the ninefold teaching of the Teacher spoken by the Buddha, the Blessed One, and remaining within what is permissible and blameless, must seek only the duty of a recluse (*samaṇadhamma*).
This, Great King, is one quality of the bamboo that should be adopted.
And this was said, Great King, by the Elder Rāhula:
“Always conforming to the ninefold word of the Buddha,
[one should act] within what is allowable and blameless.”
"Having stood, he crossed over the state of woe.
Thus ends the seventh inquiry, the Inquiry on the Bamboo Thicket.
